# Requirements

## User stories
- As a shopper, I can browse a product catalog with images, prices and stock levels.
- As a shopper, I can add items to a cart and pay with Stripe Checkout.
- As an admin, I can create, edit and archive products.

## Constraints
- Payments must never touch our servers: Stripe Checkout handles card data.
- The catalog must load in under 1 second for 500 products.

## Business rules
- An order is confirmed only after the Stripe `checkout.session.completed` webhook arrives.

# System Design

## Architecture
- **Frontend:** React + Vite SPA served from IBM Code Engine (port 3000).
- **Backend:** FastAPI service on IBM Code Engine (port 8000).
- **Database:** IBM Cloud Databases for PostgreSQL, isolated schema `app_proj_8f92a`.
- **Secrets:** `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` and `DATABASE_URL` stored in IBM Secrets Manager.

## Data model
| Table | Columns |
| --- | --- |
| products | id, name, price_cents, stock, image_url, archived |
| orders | id, stripe_session_id, status, total_cents, created_at |

## API
| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | /products | List products |
| POST | /checkout | Create a Stripe Checkout session |
| POST | /webhooks/stripe | Confirm paid orders |
